strategies.name: EMA_Support_Scalp
strategies.entry_summary: Identify support levels using the 13 EMA on a 5-minute chart and enter a trade when the price touches or bounces off this support.
strategies.exit_summary: Exit the trade after a quick move, aiming for a small profit (e.g., a few green candles) or riding the move to resistance.
